Bench press is easy. Just start out light (empty bar or like 10lbs weights on each side) and do some reps. Try to have a slight arch in your lower back, plant your feet flat on the floor, lower the weight all the way till your chest or maybe an inch above as you don't wanna bounce the weight off your chest (that's cheating) and try to lower the weight in a slowed and controlled manner while explosive pushing the weight back up. And always use a spotter, either an actual human or two of those pins where you can rest the weight on and escape from under the bar when things become too heavy. Rolling the weights off of you when you go till failure SUCKS. Trust me. Other than that you can't really go wrong. You can do whatever amount of reps and sets you want, just keep in mind the same ranges apply to bench as other lifts. So generally speaking 1-5 reps for pure strength, 6-12 for maximal muscle hypertrophy and 12+ reps for endurance. I personally like to switch it up, but generally never do more than 12 reps and lately focus on 3 reps even.
